We need to propose retrosynthesis route using templates in order: 324324, then 1914396, then 733. Must have at least 3 reactions, so exactly three steps using those templates sequentially. Need to generate JSON tree: root molecule target, child reaction with template 324324, its children are precursors (molecules). Then each precursor may be further broken down using next template etc. Likely linear route: each reaction splits one molecule into two precursors, then each of those may be further broken down. But we need to apply templates in order. Probably first reaction (template 324324) applied to target yields some precursors. Then for each precursor, apply next template 1914396 to one of them, then 733 to resulting precursor, etc. Could also apply sequentially on one branch.

We need to check applicability of each template to appropriate intermediate. Use tool apply_template to see precursors.

Let's apply template 324324 to target.
